title.zh: 马尔可夫链 · 下一步只看现在
title.en: Markov Chains · The Next Step Depends Only on Now

desc.zh: 天气、网页浏览、赌徒的本金：只要“明天只取决于今天”，转移矩阵的幂次里就会浮现一个稳态。
desc.en: Weather, web browsing, a gambler’s fortune: whenever “tomorrow depends only on today”, a steady state emerges from the powers of the transition matrix.
